package api
import "net/http"
func Router(debug bool) *http.ServeMux {
    mux := http.NewServeMux()
    mux.HandleFunc("GET /gauges", ListGauges)
    mux.HandleFunc("GET /gauges/{id}", ReadGauge)
    mux.HandleFunc("GET /levels", Levels)
    mux.HandleFunc("POST /readings", AddReading)
    if debug { mux.HandleFunc("GET /debug/raw", RawReadings) }
    return mux
}
